content.text:
No. The VitePress build does not currently write either schema.

- `docs:assets` stages other assets, but has no schema-copy step: [docs/package.json](docs/package.json#L37-L43)
- The schemas are included in the `@pantoken/i18n-engine` package itself: [tools/i18n-engine/package.json](tools/i18n-engine/package.json#L10-L16)
- The `$id` values such as `https://pantoken.app/schemas/i18n.config.schema.json` are declarative URLs, not automatically hosted files: [i18n.config.schema.json](tools/i18n-engine/i18n.config.schema.json#L2-L4)
- Neither schema exists under `docs/public`, and there is no current `docs/dist`.

So editor tooling can reference those URLs, but production requests to `/schemas/...` will not be served by the VitePress site unless a separate hosting rule or copy step exists outside this repository.
